required_capabilities.use: Build/test/Git/PowerShell/diagnostics. Explicit cwd, one command per call, inspect exit code.
Precise repository reads/writes. Read before write, atomic replace, reread after write.
Remote metadata/issues/branches/PR/review. No remote mutation before local gates.
Recall governing/source evidence. Query with exact terms; verify retrieved claims in files.
Pure JSON/schema/table/diff computation. Never a product runtime or Node dependency.
After workspace lock only and only when assigned: compact run-scoped ADR/blocker index. Never selects workspace, task, or latest handoff.
After workspace lock only: replace the exact run-scoped cursor key with MEMORY_CURSOR.json. Never write global/latest keys.
